topics.note: Meta documents 52 layers, the repeating attention pattern, a 2,048-token sliding window, and RoPE only on local layers. This supports plausibility, not quality.

"muse-glimmer-30b-nvidia-nvfp4":
    name: Muse Glimmer 30B NVIDIA NVFP4
    description: NVIDIA ModelOpt mixed NVFP4/FP8/BF16 canary with experimental 262,144-token YaRN extension
    capabilities:
      in: ["text", "image"]
      out: ["text"]
      tools: true
      context: 262144
    metadata:
      reasoning: true
      thinking: true
      vision: true
      reasoning_effort: [low, medium, high, xhigh]
    macros:
      checkpoint: "nvidia/Muse-Glimmer-30B-NVFP4"
      # DFlash needs 32 concurrent sequences; the NVIDIA card's non-DFlash
      # command uses 64. Keep the canary scheduler identical to production.
      MAX_NUM_SEQS: "32"
    proxy: http://vllm-muse-glimmer-nvidia:8000
    cmd: >-
      ${DOCKER_PREFIX}
      --name vllm-muse-glimmer-nvidia
      ${VLLM_IMAGE}
      ${VLLM_COMMON}
      # Experimental 2x extension. vLLM applies this nested override before
      # validating --max-model-len, so the Hugging Face cache stays immutable.
      # YaRN only affects the 39 local RoPE layers; the 13 global layers are NoPE.
      --hf-overrides '{"text_config":{"max_position_embeddings":262144,"rope_parameters":{"rope_type":"yarn","factor":2.0,"original_max_position_embeddings":131072,"rope_theta":500000.0}}}'
      --max-model-len 262144
      --gpu-memory-utilization 0.80
      --kv-cache-dtype fp8
      --enable-chunked-prefill
      --mamba-cache-mode align
      --reasoning-parser muse_glimmer
      --tool-call-parser muse_glimmer
      --enable-auto-tool-choice
      --generation-config auto
      --speculative-config '{"method":"dflash","model":"meta-models/Muse-Glimmer-30B-assistant","num_speculative_tokens":15}'
    cmdStop: docker stop --time 90 vllm-muse-glimmer-nvidia

llama-swap:
    container_name: llama-swap-vllm
    image: ghcr.io/mspiegel31/llama-swap-vllm:latest
    pull_policy: always
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "11437:8080"
    networks:
      - backend
    # GPU device so in-container nvidia-smi works for /metrics; no VRAM is
    # allocated unless a CUDA context is created (the router never does).
    deploy:
      resources:
        reservations:
          devices:
            - driver: nvidia
              count: 1
              capabilities: [gpu]
    stop_grace_period: 2m
    environment:
      - LLAMA_SWAP_API_KEY=${LLAMA_SWAP_API_KEY:?Set LLAMA_SWAP_API_KEY in Portainer}
      - HF_TOKEN=${HF_TOKEN:?Set HF_TOKEN in Portainer}
    command: ["--config", "/config/current/services/llama-swap-vllm/config.yaml", "--listen", "0.0.0.0:8080"]
    volumes:
      - llama-swap-config:/config:ro
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
